caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth with tender chashu pork and crisp nori. Topped with menma and a pink “e” fish cake, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table, warmly lit to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and smooth texture.
Chashu pork slice, pale pink, tender texture, irregular shape, speckled with dark sesame seeds on surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible speckles.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles with visible green onions and a pink flower-shaped garnish.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale tan, slightly glossy, with a cylindrical shape and faint speckles on their surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: white, scalloped-edged, with pink 'e' swirl on smooth surface.
